title: App
description: An app folder's peers.app.json (ADR 0006). The folder is a small web app that Peers shows in a sandboxed frame: its own files, plus read-only access to the vault paths listed in `reads`. Internet access to the origins in `network` waits until the owner allows it.

name.description: What the tree and the app's header call it. Defaults to the folder's name.

entry.description: The page that opens first, relative to the app folder. Defaults to index.html.

reads.description: Vault paths the app may read besides its own folder, as layout patterns (`*` within one segment, `**` any depth). A folder pattern covers everything inside it.

network.description: HTTPS origins the app may load from and talk to, once the owner allows it, for example a CDN or an API. A leading `*.` covers subdomains.
